title: Mount engram_source_root_naming.rs from tests/mod.rs instead of by #[path] under the turn-observations test module
outcome:
Raised as a Note by Claude /review-code in tm-5gi4 round 17 (delegation-49be8fca, src/tests/engram_turn_observations.rs:1818).
src/tests/engram_source_root_naming.rs is mounted with #[path] inside tests::engram_host_adapter::turn_observations so it can reuse that module's fixtures. tests/mod.rs has a pointer comment, but the file cannot be found from mod.rs's module list.
It depends on 6 turn_observations helpers (ClaimedRoot, add_claimed_root_worktree, received_prompt, named_root_turn, finish_claimed_turn, content_revision_of) and 5 engram_host_adapter test helpers (bind_reply, grant_reply, begin_reply, checkpoint_reply, test_control_work_binding).
Fix: move those fixtures into a shared test-support module, or widen them to pub(crate), and mount the file directly from tests/mod.rs. Test-only; land it as a pure move, separate from features.
